# Neuromorphic_Chiplet

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A chiplet designed with spiking neural network or neuromorphic computing primitives, often integrated heterogeneously with conventional logic or memory chiplets. Allows iNEST to build scalable, energy-efficient neuromorphic systems by composing multiple specialized chiplets with tailored learning and inference capabilities.
